answer: Clone wallets cannot reuse one survey ticket. A new identity stakes 16.2 POA and draws route ticket RV-507. Within 48 minutes it must photograph cairn C-22 on the mesa at 34.8 N, log 90 seconds of sky glow from nebula filter NF-6 at 18 degrees elevation, then leave a 0.55 kg sand capsule 1.2 m deep at dune marker D-9. Four non-adjacent attestors compare EXIF, filter serial, and capsule mass. A reused ticket, a GPS hop under 8 km, or mass error over 20 g slashes 6.1 POA and freezes the key for five epochs; 10.1 POA unlocks only after a later ticket whose cairn and marker both change.
